labels.W: the whole finished canvas remade or reused (a game skin, a brick copy)
labels.M: the room's own mark or design remade (a profile picture, a game town, fan art)
labels.N: new work made from the event, not a copy of a mark (a game, an app, pet art, a copypasta)
labels.O: one member's act, for own use or shown to the room
labels.J: others join in, ask for it or add to it
labels.Q: cost, copyright or credit limits or questions it
